kind: Mathematical table and ordinary C provenance for source-built MACT CRC
source_ancestry: Original MACT C text and CRC.h are absent from the pinned reconstruction tree. This C is newly reconstructed from the complete original CRC member instructions, public/self-external scope, signed table loads, buffer loads, counter and shift operations. The original object is reference-only and supplies no source output payload.

table_derivation.name: CRC-16/IBM
table_derivation.recipe: For each integer i in 0..255, start value=i and repeat eight times: value=(value>>1) XOR (0xA001 if value AND 1 else 0). Emit each result as its mathematical signed-short representative.
table_derivation.complete_table_proof: All 512 native DATA bytes compared in the unchanged complete module verifier.

abi_scope.table: static signed16 short crc16tab[256], with local PUBDEF and self-local EXTDEF retained
abi_scope.update: CRC and data operands use32-bit signed int arithmetic; low8 of CRC XOR data index the table, arithmetic shift by8 combines with sign-extended short table value. The low16 bits are the CRC update; original caller-side narrowing and historical typedef spelling are not uniquely established.
abi_scope.calculate: Unsigned8 buffer reads, unsigned32 length and counter, signed32 accumulator initialized0. Explicit unsigned16 table conversion keeps the zero-seeded result in16 bits. All complete native instructions, operand widths, loop and return tail match.

producer.derivation: Measured /4r /s /ort baseline used MOVSX and a different loop. Pentium /5r emits the original signed-short load plus arithmetic shift; /ol produces the original pretested loop. Explicit meaningful index/shift/table-XOR sequencing reproduces CalculateCRC scheduling and complete tail. No ASM fallback, pragmas, opaque arrays, dead fillers or instruction payloads.

copyright_license_scope: Original MACT authorship/copyright and C source license are unresolved. No source license is inferred solely from bundled binary provenance; this private reconstruction is not labelled GPL and is not authorized for external publication/distribution.
remaining_scope: Exactly one complete member contribution. Other MACT members and complete executable linking/binding/identity remain unfinished.
